_comment: GENERATED by tools/parse-scenes.py - do not hand-edit. Bank 5's scene tables, tile lists, metatile set records and metatile data.

regions.name: Scenes: 39 x 3
regions.description: Read by $ACA9 (entry $8000) at $AD91 + 3A: a tile-list index, a metatile-set record index and a nametable-record index, $FF for none. Labyrinth area n is scene n + 5 (bank 7 $EEE0 stores $50 + 5 in $5C); corridors use scenes 32-38 through bank 7 $EF55; special rooms 16-31. 39 scenes end exactly where the tile-list pointer table begins. HARDWARE: a labyrinth savestate has $5C = 5 at area 0, and replaying its scenes rebuilds its background CHR and set pointers.

regions.name: Tile-list pointers: 15
regions.description: $ACC7 LDA $AE06,Y with Y = 2 x the scene's first byte. 15 entries (one zero), ending where the set-record table begins; scenes use 0-14.

regions.name: Metatile-set record pointers: 22
regions.description: $AD1C LDA $AE24,Y. 22 entries, zero where unused, ending where the nametable-record table begins; scenes use 0-21.

regions.name: Nametable-record pointers: 8
regions.description: $AD5E LDA $AE50,Y. 8 entries, ending at their own first target $AE60.

regions.name: Nametable records and palette lists
regions.description: Eight [flags][pointer] records - the first with eight more bytes for $0199, flag bit 1 - then the palette lists they name: up to eight indices into $B30A, $FE ending a short one, walked by $D92D. They cover this stretch byte for byte and end where the tile lists begin.

regions.name: Tile lists: 14
regions.description: [count] then count x [tile][bank][block]: $ACD6 decompresses each block through $C042 to background CHR $1000 + tile x 16; bit 7 on a block adds $5C AND $0F. The lists tile this stretch exactly and end on the first set record. HARDWARE: replaying a labyrinth savestate's scenes rebuilds 159 of 159 background tiles, a corridor savestate's 141 of 142.

regions.name: Metatile-set record: 1 sets
regions.description: [count] then count x [set | object list << 4][tile base][pointer]: $AD1A loads $0478, $0470 and $0460/$0468 for each set. Sets: 0 at $AF1C. It points at itself: its five bytes are also metatile 0 of set 0.

regions.name: Metatiles, 85 bytes
regions.description: Metatile data: 5 bytes each - four tile numbers ($FF blank) and a fifth whose low three bits pick the attribute slot in $0199 and whose high nibble names a ground object - read by $83B3 through a set window of 32 metatiles (AND #$1F, x5). Every byte here lies inside some set window. Windows overlap, so a metatile can belong to several sets. HARDWARE: all 192 room cells of a labyrinth savestate are metatiles of its live sets. Which of a window's 32 ids a game actually uses is not established - a window can run past real data.
